{"script":"start=$(date -Iseconds)
rm -rf temp_var_count
mkdir temp_var_count
# 2. raw listing (NUL-separated)
find /var -mindepth 0 -print0 > temp_var_count/var_listing.raw
# 3. normalize/extract full paths (one per line)
tr '\0' '\n' < temp_var_count/var_listing.raw | sed '/^$/d' > temp_var_count/all_paths.txt
# 4. regular files only
( while IFS= read -r p; do [ -f "$p" ] && printf '%s\n' "$p"; done < temp_var_count/all_paths.txt ) > temp_var_count/regular_files.txt
# 5. symlink resolution
: > temp_var_count/symlink_resolution.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -L "$p" ]; then
    target=$(readlink "$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
    resolved=$(readlink -f "$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -z "$resolved" ]; then status="broken"; else
      case "$resolved" in /var/*) status="inside /var";; *) status="outside /var";; esac
    fi
    printf '%s -> %s | resolved: %s | status: %s\n' "$p" "$target" "$resolved" "$status" >> temp_var_count/symlink_resolution.txt
  fi
done < temp_var_count/all_paths.txt
# 6. file identity attributes and deduplication (device:inode)
while IFS= read -r f; do
  stat -c '%d:%i\t%n' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
done < temp_var_count/regular_files.txt > temp_var_count/file_identities.txt
sort -u -t$'\t' -k1,1 temp_var_count/file_identities.txt > temp_var_count/file_identities_sorted.txt
awk -F $'\t' '!seen[$1]++{print $2}' temp_var_count/file_identities_sorted.txt > temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt
# 7. verify existence and accessibility
: > temp_var_count/missing_or_inaccessible.log
tmpfile=$(mktemp)
while IFS= read -r f; do
  if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then echo "MISSING: $f" >> temp_var_count/missing_or_inaccessible.log
  elif [ ! -r "$f" ]; then echo "INACCESSIBLE: $f" >> temp_var_count/missing_or_inaccessible.log
  else printf '%s\n' "$f" >> "$tmpfile"
  fi
done < temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt
mv "$tmpfile" temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt
# 8. audit metadata
end=$(date -Iseconds)
echo "snapshot_start: $start" > temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt
echo "snapshot_end: $end" >> temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt
echo "steps:" >> temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt
echo "1 created clean workspace temp_var_count and removed prior artifacts" >> temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt
echo "2 saved recursive raw listing to var_listing.raw (NUL-separated via find -print0)" >> temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt
echo "3 normalized and extracted full paths to all_paths.txt" >> temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt
echo "4 filtered regular files to regular_files.txt" >> temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt
echo "5 resolved symlinks to symlink_resolution.txt" >> temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt
echo "6 computed device:inode and deduplicated to dedup_files.txt" >> temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt
echo "7 verified accessibility and logged missing/inaccessible entries" >> temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt
echo "8 saved audit metadata" >> temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt
echo "9 prepared final_input_for_count.txt (deduplicated, verified list)" >> temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt
sha256sum temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt 2>/dev/null >> temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt || true
# 9. finalize
cp temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt temp_var_count/final_input_for_count.txt
# counts
physical_count=$(find /var -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
dedup_count=$(wc -l < temp_var_count/final_input_for_count.txt)
printf 'PHYSICAL_COUNT:%s\n' "$physical_count"
printf 'DEDUP_COUNT:%s\n' "$dedup_count"
"}
